source_caption_text:
Follow (us) @Records for more 🙏

2 teenagers really gave us one of the most iconic songs in history 😮‍💨🔥

Mobb Deep’s “Shook Ones, Pt. II” has surpassed 760 MILLION streams on Spotify over 30 years after its release 😮‍💨🔥

Released in 1995 as the lead single from “The Infamous,” the record peaked at No. 59 on the Billboard Hot 100. Decades later, it remains Mobb Deep’s most-streamed song on Spotify, with more than 764 million plays.

Havoc’s production and Prodigy’s opening verse helped turn it into a defining record of New York hip-hop and those streaming numbers show how many people are still discovering it and coming back.

Is this the greatest hip-hop beat ever made? 👀👇

RIP Prodigy 🕊️
